Replace the two exterior intervals by (-R,-1] and (1,R], with δ=(R−1)/ceil(log x). Cell lengths are ((R−1)c/2+o(1))φ(q)√x, hence exceed q for every fixed c>0 at large x; log(Y_j/q)=½log x+O_R,c(loglog x).

q=1 satisfies the family condition with η=log(x)/√x→0. For each fixed α≥0 choose c strictly between (U+2αM)/D_B and the displayed safe line. Then (cD₄−∥F∥₁)/(2M)>α because D₄≥D_B>0 and ∥F∥₁≤U; hence liminf normalized count>α and C_RH(α)<safe line. No uniform onset in α or finite-x statement is asserted.
